title: AI Agile PR Review
description: Schema for result.json's `review` field on a step whose pipeline.json entry declares outcome_policy.kind == "review_findings" (issue #512 Part 2). The model reports findings; pipeline_orchestrator.py's review_outcome.derive_review_verdict computes the verdict from them, never the model's own outcome field.

head_sha.description: The PR head commit SHA this review was performed against. Carried through so a later part can compare it with the live PR head before marking ready (issue #512 Part 3); unused by Part 2's own verdict computation.

id.description: Unique within this review's findings array -- duplicates are a malformed review (review_outcome.find_duplicate_finding_ids).

category.description: The fundamental classification: a defect is something that must be true (correctness, spec, security, tests, standards, or cross-file/test consistency); an improvement is genuinely optional -- if a change is necessary to satisfy the approved PDD or correct a security, correctness, standards, or testing defect, it is a defect, not an improvement (issue #506).

type.description: The technical area a defect relates to. Required for category "defect"; must be omitted for category "improvement".

severity.description: Technical impact of a defect. Required for category "defect"; must be omitted for category "improvement" -- an improvement has no severity, only an effort.

effort.description: How much work an improvement takes to action, deciding its disposition (review_outcome.improvement_disposition): simple -> fix-if-coder-cycle, medium -> ask-human, complex -> defer. Required for category "improvement"; must be omitted for category "defect".

confidence.description: The reviewer's own confidence this finding is real. On a defect, a non-Critical finding below 0.8 does not block (review_outcome.finding_blocks).

path.description: Repo-relative file path this finding is about. Omit for a finding that is not scoped to one file (e.g. a merge-conflict or missing-base-doc finding).

line.description: Omit alongside path for a finding that is not scoped to one file.

evidence.description: What in the diff or PR head supports this finding.

fix.description: Step-by-step fix precise enough for the coder agent to implement.

standard.description: The P-N or STD ID this finding cites. Required for a defect with type "standard"; optional otherwise.

adr.description: An ADR ID the finding claims covers it. Verified against adrs.json's own authorises_exception_to, never trusted from this claim alone (review_outcome.adr_exception_index).
